data.name: Help
data.value:
HDRpilot command line (diagnostics and tests)
hdrpilot hdr status [--json] [--api modern|legacy] Lists all active displays with name, HDR-capable and HDR on/off. hdrpilot hdr on|off|toggle [--display <selection>] [--api modern|legacy] [--hotkey-fallback] [--json] Switches HDR and confirms the state by reading it again. <selection>: primary (default), all, number from "hdr status", part of the name or monitorDevicePath.
hdrpilot scan [--source <source>] [--search "<folder>;<folder>"] [--config-dir <folder>] Prints all games found and the errors per scanner as JSON (read-only). <source>: Steam, Epic, Xbox, Gog, Ubisoft, EA, BattleNet, Quiver With --config-dir, the search folders and learned Quiver folders of that storage count too.
hdrpilot games list [--json] hdrpilot games import Scans all launchers and applies the result to the configuration. hdrpilot games add --path <exe|folder> [--name <name>] [--hdr on|off] hdrpilot games set <key> [--hdr on|off] [--restore on|off] [--display <monitorDevicePath>|global] Key: Source:ID, such as Steam:1091500 (see "games list"). hdrpilot watch [--verbose] Monitors game launches in the foreground (like the app, without a user interface). Press Ctrl+C to stop. hdrpilot run <key> Launch via HDRpilot: turn HDR on, confirm, launch the game, monitor until the game ends. scan, games, watch and run: --config-dir <folder> (instead of %APPDATA%/%LOCALAPPDATA%\HDRpilot, for tests).
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 wrong usage, 3 display not found, 4 display without HDR, 5 switching failed, 6 game not found
